基于 Transformer 架构的大规模语言模型，通过预测下一个 token训练。

enShortDesc: Large language model: a Transformer-based neural network trained on massive text corpora to predict the next token — the engine behind vibe coding.
enLongDesc:
A large language model (LLM) is a Transformer-based neural network trained on a massive text corpus to predict the next token.

That single trick — next-token prediction at scale — is the engine behind vibe coding: it's what powers modern AI coding agents.

Representative models: Claude Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5; GPT-5 / GPT-5.2; Gemini 3 Pro; DeepSeek V3.2; Qwen 3; Llama 4.

name: Transformer
shortDesc: 使用注意力而非循环/卷积的神经网络架构。2017 年 Google 论文《Attention Is All You Need》。
longDesc:
2017 年 Google 论文《Attention Is All You Need》提出的架构，使用注意力（attention）取代 RNN/CNN。

核心组件：

  • Self-Attention：序列内部关系
  • Multi-Head Attention：多组并行注意力
  • Positional Encoding：位置信息
  • FFN：前馈网络

quotes.text: Attention is all you need.
quotes.cite: Vaswani et al. 2017 论文标题

seeAlso.name: Attention Is All You Need (原论文)

examples.code:
# Transformer block（简化伪代码）
# 论文：Vaswani et al. "Attention Is All You Need" (2017)
def transformer_block(x):
    # Self-attention + 残差 + LayerNorm
    attn_out = layer_norm(x + multi_head_attention(x))
    # FFN + 残差 + LayerNorm
    ffn_out  = layer_norm(attn_out + feed_forward(attn_out))
    return ffn_out

# GPT (decoder-only): N 个 transformer_block 堆叠
# BERT (encoder-only): 同上但用 encoder mask
# T5 (encoder-decoder): encoder + decoder 组合
examples.desc: Transformer block 核心结构伪代码

enShortDesc: The neural architecture underlying all modern LLMs. Introduced in 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al. 2017).
enLongDesc: The Transformer architecture (Vaswani et al. 2017) uses self-attention to process sequences in parallel. Foundation of GPT, BERT, T5, and essentially all modern LLMs.

name: Attention Mechanism
shortDesc: 神经网络中动态加权输入相关性的组件。Transformer 的核心。
longDesc:
神经网络中动态加权输入相关性的组件。

类型：

  • Self-Attention：序列内部
  • Cross-Attention：跨序列
  • Multi-Head：多组并行
  • Multi-Query (MQA)：单 KV 多 Q
  • Grouped-Query (GQA)：分组 KV

quotes.text: Attention is all you need.

examples.code:
# Scaled Dot-Product Attention (Vaswani et al. 2017)
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def attention(Q, K, V, mask=None):
    # Q, K, V: (batch, heads, seq, d_k)
    d_k = Q.size(-1)
    scores = (Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)) / (d_k ** 0.5)   # (batch, heads, seq, seq)
    if mask is not None:
        scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, float('-inf'))
    weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    return weights @ V                                    # (batch, heads, seq, d_k)

# Multi-Head = parallel multiple attention() with different Q/K/V projections
# 8 heads × d_k=64 → 总维度 512（同单 head 的 d_model）
examples.desc: Scaled Dot-Product Attention PyTorch 实现

seeAlso.name: Attention Is All You Need 论文

enShortDesc: The mechanism that lets models weigh the relevance of different input tokens to each other. Foundation of the Transformer.
enLongDesc: Attention computes a weighted sum of values, where weights come from query-key dot products. Scaled dot-product attention is the standard variant.

longDesc:
LLM 单次推理可"看到"的最大 token 数。

  • Claude Opus 4.6：1M tokens

  • Gemini 3 Pro：2M tokens

quotes.text: In 2026, 1M tokens is the standard. Claude Opus 4.6 ships 1M. Gemini 2.5 Pro goes to 2M. Even GPT stays behind at 128K default.

2026 standard: Claude Opus 4.6 ships 1M, Gemini 2.5 Pro reaches 2M, GPT-4o default 128K.

name: Tokens
shortDesc: 模型把文本切分成最小处理单元的过程和单位。
longDesc:
模型把文本切分成最小处理单元的过程和单位。

估算：

  • 英文：1 token ≈ 4 字符 / 0.75 词
  • 中文：1 token ≈ 1-2 字

enLongDesc: Tokens are the atomic units of LLM input/output. Text is split into tokens via BPE or WordPiece. ~0.75 English words per token, ~1.5 Chinese characters. Pricing and context limits are measured in tokens.

name: Hallucination
shortDesc: LLM 在缺乏依据时生成看似合理但虚构的内容。vibe coding 的主要风险。
longDesc:
LLM 在缺乏依据时生成看似合理但虚构的内容。

类型：

  • Factuality Hallucination：事实错误
  • Faithfulness Hallucination：与给定上下文不一致

vibe coding 中的表现：

  • 编造不存在的 API / 库
  • 引用不存在的文档
  • 写出"看起来对但跑不起来"的代码

enShortDesc: When an LLM confidently states false information. The #1 reliability problem with LLMs.
enLongDesc: A hallucination occurs when an LLM generates plausible but factually incorrect text, including invented citations, URLs, APIs, or facts. Mitigation: grounding via RAG, citations, and explicit uncertainty.

enLongDesc: The agent loop is the fundamental iteration pattern of AI agents: gather context, plan action, execute, observe result, verify, repeat until done or fail.

name: Subagent
shortDesc: 由主 agent 派生的子 agent，负责专门子任务。有自己的 context window。
longDesc:
由主 agent 派生的子 agent，负责专门子任务。

与 Agent Teams 的区别：

  • Agent Teams：多个独立 session，每个有独立 context window，可直接交互

典型用法：

  • 子 agent 负责 context gathering / test coverage / conflict resolution

实践：Claude Code 的 Task 工具、spawn_agent

quotes.text: Subagents run within a single session and report only to the parent.

enShortDesc: MCP (Model Context Protocol): Anthropic's Nov 2024 open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools and data sources — "the USB-C port for AI applications."
enLongDesc:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard Anthropic released in November 2024 for connecting AI agents to external tools and data sources. Think of it as the USB / OpenAPI of the AI era: one standard that replaces per-tool integrations.

The core pieces:

  • MCP server: a process that exposes tools
  • MCP client: the client built into the agent
  • The protocol: JSON-RPC over stdio / HTTP

MCP Tool Search: tool schemas load on demand so they don't eat the context window.

name: Embedding
shortDesc: 文本/图像/音频的数值向量表示，编码语义信息。
longDesc:
文本/图像/音频的密集数值向量表示，编码语义信息。

用途：

  • 语义搜索（cosine similarity）
  • RAG 检索
  • 聚类、分类

模型：OpenAI text-embedding-3 / Cohere embed-v3 / Voyage / BGE / MTEB leaderboard。

client = OpenAI()

resp = client.embeddings.create(
    model="text-embedding-3-small",   # 1536 维
    input="Vibe coding 是 Andrej Karpathy 提出的术语",
    encoding_format="float",

# 语义相似度：
import numpy as np
def cosine(a, b): return np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b))

quotes.text: An embedding is a numerical representation of a piece of text, useful for search, clustering, recommendations.

enShortDesc: A dense numerical vector representing text, used for semantic search and similarity comparisons.
enLongDesc: An embedding maps text into a high-dimensional vector space where semantically similar texts are close together. Foundation of vector search and modern RAG systems.

name: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
shortDesc: 从外部知识库检索相关文档，再让 LLM 基于检索结果生成回答。
longDesc:
RAG 通过检索外部知识库增强 LLM 输出，避免幻觉和过时信息。

流程：

  1. 查询 → embedding
  2. 在向量数据库中检索相似文档
  3. 文档作为 context 注入 prompt
  4. LLM 基于文档生成回答

变体：GraphRAG / HyDE / Self-RAG / CRAG

examples.code:

→ prompt_with_context(query, context) → llm.generate() → answer

基于以下 context 回答，最后引用来源编号：

<context>
{context}
</context>

Question: {input}
""")

rag_chain = create_retrieval_chain(retriever, question_answer_chain)

quotes.text: RAG: a way to give the model access to additional information that's not in its training data.

seeAlso.name: Lewis et al. 2020 RAG 原始论文

enShortDesc: Retrieve relevant documents from your knowledge base, then let the LLM generate an answer grounded in what was retrieved.
enLongDesc:
RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) strengthens LLM output by retrieving from an external knowledge base first — grounding the model in fresh facts and cutting down on hallucinations and stale information.

How it works:

  1. Query → embedding
  2. Retrieve similar documents from a vector database
  3. Inject the documents into the prompt as context
  4. The LLM generates the answer from those documents

Variants: GraphRAG / HyDE / Self-RAG / CRAG

The technique comes from Lewis et al., 2020 ("Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks").

quotes.text: Vector databases store and query high-dimensional embedding vectors.

enShortDesc: A database optimized for storing and querying high-dimensional embedding vectors (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
enLongDesc: A vector database stores embeddings and supports similarity search (k-nearest neighbors) at scale. Examples: Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector.

name: Cosine Similarity
shortDesc: 两个 embedding 向量夹角的余弦值，衡量语义相似度。RAG 检索最常用度量。
longDesc:
两个 embedding 向量夹角的余弦值，衡量语义相似度。

取值范围：[-1, 1]，越接近 1 越相似。

替代指标：

  • 点积（Dot Product）
  • 欧氏距离（Euclidean L2）

RAG 经验：如果检索结果不相关，问题通常在检索阶段——调整相似度阈值或换检索算法。

examples.code:
# Cosine Similarity: 衡量两个向量的方向相似度
import numpy as np

def cosine_similarity(a, b):
    """
    Returns: -1 (opposite) to 1 (same direction)
    Formula: cos(θ) = (a · b) / (||a|| × ||b||)
    """
    dot = np.dot(a, b)
    norm_a = np.linalg.norm(a)
    norm_b = np.linalg.norm(b)
    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)

# Embedding 相似度示例：
emb_cat   = [0.8, 0.2, 0.1]   # "cat" 的 embedding
emb_dog   = [0.7, 0.3, 0.1]   # "dog"
emb_table = [0.1, 0.8, 0.5]   # "table"

print(cosine_similarity(emb_cat, emb_dog))      # → 0.99 (高)
print(cosine_similarity(emb_cat, emb_table))    # → 0.32 (低)

# vs Euclidean distance: 对向量长度敏感
# Cosine: 只关心方向（更适合 NLP embedding）
examples.desc: Cosine similarity 实现 + 与 Euclidean 对比

quotes.text: Cosine similarity measures the angle between vectors, ignoring magnitude. Ideal for comparing normalized embeddings.

enShortDesc: Similarity metric for vectors: measures the angle between them, ignoring magnitude. Standard for embedding comparisons.
enLongDesc: Cosine similarity = (a · b) / (||a|| × ||b||). Returns -1 (opposite) to 1 (same direction). Ideal for normalized embeddings because it ignores magnitude.

name: Chunking (RAG)
shortDesc: 把文档分成片段以便向量数据库索引。重叠（overlap）保证语义连贯。
longDesc:
RAG 中把文档分成片段以便索引和检索。

策略：

  • 固定大小：每 N 个 token
  • 句子/段落：按语法边界
  • 语义切片：按主题

Overlap / Stride：相邻片段有重叠避免语义断裂。

examples.code:
# LangChain: 文档 chunking
from langchain.text_splitter import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter

splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
    chunk_size=1000,        # 每个 chunk 1000 字符
    chunk_overlap=200,      # 相邻 chunk 重叠 200 字符（保留上下文）
    separators=["\n\n", "\n", " ", ""],
)

chunks = splitter.split_text(long_document)
print(len(chunks))   # → ~200 chunks

# 选 chunk_size 的经验：
#   - 512: 适合 QA、检索（细粒度）
#   - 1024: 适合大多数 RAG
#   - 2048: 适合长文档摘要
examples.desc: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter chunking

quotes.text: Chunking strategy is the most underrated part of RAG. Wrong chunk size kills retrieval quality.

enShortDesc: Splitting long documents into smaller pieces for embedding and retrieval. Strategy choice (size, overlap) significantly affects RAG quality.
enLongDesc: Chunking divides documents into processable pieces (typically 500-2000 tokens). Chunk size and overlap are the most underrated RAG parameters.

name: Reranker (Cross-Encoder)
shortDesc: RAG 第二阶段：用 cross-encoder 联合打分 query + 候选文档，提升排序质量。
longDesc:
RAG 检索的第二阶段——用 cross-encoder 模型联合打分query 和候选文档。

流程：

  1. Bi-encoder 粗排：快速取出 top-K（100+）
  2. Cross-encoder 重排：精确排序 top-K → top-N

代表：Cohere Rerank 3 / BGE Reranker / ColBERT

examples.code:
# Reranker: 把 vector search 的 top-K 结果按相关性重排
# Stage 1: Vector search (fast, ~10ms)
# Stage 2: Rerank top-20 with cross-encoder (slow but accurate, ~200ms)
# Stage 3: 选 top-5 注入 prompt

from sentence_transformers import CrossEncoder

reranker = CrossEncoder('cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2')

# Vector search 返回 20 个候选
candidates = vector_store.search(query, top_k=20)

# Cross-encoder 打分
pairs = [[query, doc.text] for doc in candidates]
scores = reranker.predict(pairs)  # shape: (20,)

# 重排并取 top-5
top_5 = [candidates[i] for i in scores.argsort()[-5:][::-1]]

# 性能提升：RAG 准确率 +15-30% (vs 纯 vector search)
examples.desc: Reranker 2-stage retrieval pipeline

enShortDesc: A second-pass model that re-scores vector search candidates for higher accuracy. Typically slower but more precise than embedding similarity.
enLongDesc: A reranker (e.g., Cohere Rerank, cross-encoder) takes the top-K results from a vector search and re-scores them with a more expensive model. Typically +15-30% retrieval accuracy.

name: GraphRAG
shortDesc: 用知识图谱增强 RAG，捕捉实体间关系。
longDesc:
GraphRAG 用知识图谱取代纯向量检索，捕捉实体间关系。

优势：

  • 回答需要跨文档推理的问题
  • 捕捉实体关系（"X 公司的创始人"）
  • 提供结构化上下文

代表实现：Microsoft GraphRAG / Neo4j + LLM

examples.code:
# GraphRAG: 用知识图谱增强 RAG
# 传统 RAG: chunk → embedding → vector search
# GraphRAG: chunk → entity extraction → graph → community detection → summary

# Microsoft GraphRAG 简化流程
from graphrag import GraphRAG

graph = GraphRAG.from_documents(docs)

# 1. 提取实体和关系
graph.extract_entities()

# 2. 构建知识图谱
graph.build_graph()

# 3. Leiden 算法分社区
communities = graph.detect_communities()

# 4. 每个社区生成 summary
graph.summarize_communities()

# 5. 查询：先用 community summary 找相关社区，再 drill down
result = graph.query("What are the key themes in this document?")

# 优势：跨 chunk 关系查询，全局摘要
# 劣势：图构建慢，索引大
examples.desc: Microsoft GraphRAG 简化流程

quotes.text: GraphRAG: knowledge graphs beat vector RAG on cross-chunk relational queries.

enShortDesc: RAG augmented with a knowledge graph: extract entities, build relationships, then query via community detection. Better for cross-chunk relational queries.
enLongDesc: GraphRAG (Microsoft, 2024) augments traditional vector RAG with a knowledge graph built from extracted entities and relationships. Enables global queries across chunks.

name: HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings)
shortDesc: 让 LLM 先生成假设性答案文档，再用其 embedding 检索真实文档。
longDesc:
HyDE：让 LLM 先生成假设性答案文档，再用其 embedding 检索真实文档。

直觉：假设答案的 embedding 与真实答案更接近，比 query embedding 检索更准。

examples.code:
# HyDE: Hypothetical Document Embeddings
# 假设文档 embedding 比问题 embedding 更接近真实文档
# 1. LLM 生成"假设性答案"（不需要正确，只需相关）
# 2. Embedding 假设答案
# 3. 用假设答案的 embedding 做 vector search

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

def hyde_search(query, vector_store, k=5):
    # 1. 生成假设答案
    hypothetical = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="gpt-4o-mini",
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": "Write a short answer to the question."},
            {"role": "user", "content": query},
        ],
    ).choices[0].message.content

    # 2. Embed 假设答案
    query_emb = client.embeddings.create(
        model="text-embedding-3-small",
        input=hypothetical,
    ).data[0].embedding

    # 3. Vector search
    return vector_store.search(query_emb, top_k=k)

# 实测：zero-shot retrieval 准确率显著提升（特别是短问题）
examples.desc: HyDE 完整 Python 实现

enShortDesc: Hypothetical Document Embeddings: generate a hypothetical answer, embed it, then search. Outperforms query embedding for short questions.
enLongDesc: HyDE (Gao et al. 2022) generates a hypothetical answer via LLM, embeds that, and uses it for vector search. The hypothesis is closer to real document space than the raw question.

name: Semantic Caching
shortDesc: 缓存相似查询的 LLM 响应，降低成本和延迟。
longDesc:
缓存语义相似查询的 LLM 响应，避免重复推理。

工作流：

  1. 查询 embedding
  2. 检索相似历史查询
  3. 命中且阈值高 → 返回缓存
  4. 未命中 → 调 LLM
enShortDesc: Cache prompt prefix to avoid recomputing KV cache on every request. Cuts cost by up to 90% for repeated system prompts.
enLongDesc: Prompt caching (Anthropic, OpenAI) lets you mark a portion of the prompt as cacheable. Subsequent requests with the same prefix reuse the KV cache, dramatically reducing latency and cost.

name: KV Cache
shortDesc: 缓存已计算的 Key/Value 矩阵，避免重复注意力计算。LLM 推理核心优化。
longDesc:
缓存已计算的 Key / Value 矩阵，避免重复注意力计算。

重要性：LLM 自回归生成每 token 都要计算所有历史 KV——没有 cache，复杂度 O(n²) → O(n³)。

衍生：

  • PagedAttention (vLLM)：分页管理 KV
  • KV Cache Quantization：量化压缩

quotes.text: Without KV cache, autoregressive generation is O(n²) per context. With it, O(n).

examples.code:
# KV Cache: Transformer 推理加速的关键
# 标准 autoregressive 生成：每生成一个 token 要重算所有之前的 attention
# → O(n²) per context

# KV Cache: 把已计算的 K, V 矩阵缓存起来
# → 新 token 只需算自己的 Q，然后和缓存的 K、V 做 attention
# → O(n) per context

# 内存代价：
#   cache_size = 2 × num_layers × seq_len × d_model × batch_size × bytes_per_param
# GPT-3 175B (96 layers, d_model=12288, fp16):
#   per token = 2 × 96 × 12288 × 2 bytes = 4.7 MB
#   2048 tokens context = 9.4 GB
# → 长 context 内存爆炸，催生 vLLM/PagedAttention 等优化
examples.desc: KV Cache 工作原理 + 内存代价

enShortDesc: Cache of key/value matrices from previous tokens during autoregressive generation. Reduces per-token computation from O(n²) to O(n).
enLongDesc: KV cache stores previously computed key and value matrices, avoiding redundant computation during text generation. Memory grows linearly with sequence length.

name: PagedAttention (vLLM)
shortDesc: vLLM 的 KV cache 分页管理，显著提升吞吐量。
longDesc:
vLLM 引入的KV cache 分页管理机制，类似操作系统的虚拟内存。

优势：

  • 消除内存碎片
  • 提高 batch 吞吐量 4-24x
  • 支持 continuous batching

examples.code:
# PagedAttention: vLLM 的 KV Cache 分页管理
# 问题：传统 KV Cache 是连续内存，长 context 会 OOM
# 解决：把 KV Cache 分成固定大小的"页"（类似 OS 虚拟内存）

from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

llm = LLM(
    model="meta-llama/Llama-3-70b",
    gpu_memory_utilization=0.9,
    block_size=16,         # 每页存 16 个 token 的 KV
    max_num_blocks_per_seq=256,   # 最长 4096 tokens
)

# 自动应用 PagedAttention
outputs = llm.generate(["Long prompt..."], SamplingParams(max_tokens=100))

# 优势：
# - 内存碎片化 ↓
# - 长 context 支持 ↑
# - batch 内不同 seq 长度高效共享 GPU
examples.desc: vLLM PagedAttention 用法

quotes.text: PagedAttention: borrow OS virtual memory ideas to manage LLM KV cache. 2-4x throughput.

enShortDesc: vLLM's memory management: page KV cache like OS virtual memory. 2-4x throughput improvement.
enLongDesc: PagedAttention (Kwon et al. SOSP 2023) borrows OS virtual memory concepts to manage LLM KV cache in fixed-size pages, reducing fragmentation and improving throughput 2-4x.

name: Speculative Decoding
shortDesc: 用小模型先生成候选 token，大模型并行验证，加速推理。
longDesc:
用小模型快速生成候选，大模型并行验证，加速推理。

适用：相同分布的小模型 + 大模型对（如 7B + 70B）。

加速比：2-3x 典型，输出质量不变。

examples.code:
# Speculative Decoding: 用小模型加速大模型推理
# 1. 小模型 (draft) 生成 K 个候选 token（快）
# 2. 大模型 (target) 一次性验证 K 个候选（并行）

# 用 HuggingFace transformers 实现
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

draft_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B").cuda()
target_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B").cuda()

# draft 生成 5 个 token
draft_tokens = draft_model.generate(input_ids, max_new_tokens=5)

# target 一次性 verify
# 接受 prefix 长度 = 直到第一个 mismatch
output = target_model.generate(
    input_ids,
    max_new_tokens=5,
    speculative_decoding=True,
    assistant_model=draft_model,
)

# 实测加速：2-3x（取决于 acceptance rate）
examples.desc: Speculative decoding 简化实现

quotes.text: Speculative decoding: small model drafts, big model verifies. Same output, 2-3x faster.

enShortDesc: Use a small draft model to generate candidates, then a large model verifies in parallel. 2-3x speedup with same output quality.
enLongDesc: Speculative decoding (Leviathan et al. 2022) uses a small fast model to draft multiple tokens, then the large model verifies them all in one forward pass. Same outputs, 2-3x faster.

name: FlashAttention
shortDesc: 通过 IO-aware 算法显著加速注意力计算并节省内存。
longDesc:
通过 IO-aware 算法显著加速注意力计算并节省内存。

原理：减少 GPU HBM ↔ SRAM 之间的 IO——attention 是 memory-bound。

版本：FlashAttention 1 / 2 / 3

examples.code:
# Flash Attention: 内存高效的 attention 计算
# 标准 attention: O(n²) 内存（存 attention matrix）
# Flash Attention: O(n) 内存（分块计算，不存中间结果）

# HuggingFace transformers 自动支持 (PyTorch 2.0+)
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
import torch

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    "Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B",
    attn_implementation="flash_attention_2",   # 启用
    torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
).cuda()

# 长 context 训练必备（节省 5-10x 显存）
examples.desc: Flash Attention 启用方式

seeAlso.name: Flash Attention 论文 (Dao et al. 2022)

quotes.text: Flash Attention: IO-aware exact attention. 2-4x wall-clock speedup, 5-10x memory reduction.

enShortDesc: IO-aware exact attention algorithm. 2-4x wall-clock speedup, 5-10x memory reduction. By Tri Dao.
enLongDesc: Flash Attention (Dao et al. NeurIPS 2022) computes exact attention via tiling and recomputation, avoiding the O(n²) memory of the standard attention matrix. HuggingFace supports it via attn_implementation="flash_attention_2".

name: Mixture of Experts (MoE)
shortDesc: 多个专家子网络 + 路由器动态激活部分参数。稀疏激活的大模型架构。
longDesc:
MoE：多个专家子网络 + 路由器动态激活部分参数。

代表：Mixtral 8x7B、DeepSeek V3 (671B 参数 / 37B 激活)、GPT-4 (传闻)。

优势：模型参数量大但推理成本可控（稀疏激活）。

quotes.text: Sparse models scale up but not out. DeepSeek V3 has 671B params but only 37B active.

examples.code:
# Mixture of Experts (MoE): 稀疏激活大模型
# DeepSeek V3: 671B 总参数，但每 token 只激活 ~37B

class MoELayer(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, num_experts=64, top_k=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = torch.nn.Linear(d_model, num_experts)
        self.experts = torch.nn.ModuleList([
            torch.nn.Sequential(
                torch.nn.Linear(d_model, d_model * 4),
                torch.nn.GELU(),
                torch.nn.Linear(d_model * 4, d_model),
            ) for _ in range(num_experts)
        ])
        self.top_k = top_k

    def forward(self, x):
        # 1. Router 决定 top-k experts
        scores = self.gate(x)                    # (batch, seq, num_experts)
        top_k_vals, top_k_idx = scores.topk(self.top_k, dim=-1)

        # 2. 只激活 top-k experts
        output = torch.zeros_like(x)
        for k in range(self.top_k):
            mask = (top_k_idx[..., k:k+1] == torch.arange(len(self.experts))).any(-1)
            # ... 复杂 index + scatter，实际用 vLLM/Switch Transformer 优化
        return output
examples.desc: MoE layer 简化实现

enShortDesc: Sparse model architecture: many 'experts' but only top-k activated per token. DeepSeek V3: 671B params, 37B active.
enLongDesc: Mixture of Experts (MoE) uses a router to select the top-k experts per token, keeping total parameter count high while active parameters per forward pass low. Enables trillion-parameter models at inference cost of much smaller ones.

name: Router / Gating
shortDesc: MoE 中决定哪个 expert 处理哪个 token 的网络。
longDesc:
MoE 中的路由器——决定哪个 expert 处理哪个 token。

训练挑战：负载均衡（避免总路由到少数 experts）。

examples.desc: Router/Gating 两种用法（MoE + 多模型）

quotes.text: Routing: route each query to the cheapest model that can handle it.

enShortDesc: A network that routes inputs to specific experts (in MoE) or to the most cost-effective model (multi-model systems).
enLongDesc: Router/Gating networks decide which expert to use per token (MoE) or which LLM to query (FrugalGPT, RouteLLM). The routing function itself can be learned or rule-based.

name: Mamba (SSM)
shortDesc: 状态空间模型（SSM），Transformer 替代架构。线性复杂度处理长序列。
longDesc:
Mamba：基于状态空间模型（SSM）的序列建模架构，被视为 Transformer 的潜在替代。

优势：线性复杂度处理超长序列。

缺点：in-context learning 能力弱于 Transformer。

代表：Mamba / Mamba-2 / Jamba (SSM + Attention 混合)

quotes.text: Mamba: Linear-time sequence modeling with selective state spaces.

examples.code:
# Mamba: 状态空间模型替代 Transformer
# 优势：线性时间复杂度 O(n) vs Transformer O(n²)
# 劣势：不适合需要精确检索的任务（vs attention）

from mamba_ssm import Mamba

model = Mamba(
    d_model=768,           # hidden dim
    d_state=16,            # SSM state dimension
    d_conv=4,              # 局部卷积核大小
    expand=2,              # 块扩展因子
).to("cuda")

# 输入: (batch, seq_len, d_model)
x = torch.randn(2, 1024, 768).to("cuda")
y = model(x)   # 输出同 shape

# Mamba-2: 改进版本，更快 + 支持 tensor parallel
# Jamba: Mamba + Attention 混合（弥补 Mamba 弱点）
examples.desc: Mamba state space model PyTorch 示例

enShortDesc: State Space Model alternative to Transformers. Linear O(n) complexity instead of quadratic. Strong for long sequences.
enLongDesc: Mamba (Gu & Dao 2023) is a selective state space model with linear-time sequence modeling. Trades off against attention for tasks requiring precise retrieval. Often combined with attention in hybrid models (e.g., Jamba).

name: RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding)
shortDesc: 通过旋转矩阵编码位置信息。现代 LLM 的主流位置编码方案。
longDesc:
RoPE：通过旋转矩阵编码位置信息——现代 LLM 主流方案。

优势：

  • 相对位置天然
  • 支持长度外推
  • 计算高效

用户：Llama / Qwen / DeepSeek / Mistral

quotes.text: RoPE encodes position by rotating the query and key vectors.

examples.code:
# RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding)
# 核心思想：把位置信息编码为 query / key 向量的旋转
# 不加 position embedding，而是旋转 Q、K 向量

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def apply_rope(x, freqs):
    """
    x:      (batch, heads, seq, d_k)
    freqs:  (seq, d_k/2) — 预计算的 sin/cos
    """
    # 把最后一维拆成两半，分别乘 cos/sin
    x_pair = x.float().reshape(*x.shape[:-1], -1, 2)
    x_real, x_imag = x_pair[..., 0], x_pair[..., 1]

    # cos/sin 旋转
    cos = freqs.cos()[None, None, :, :]
    sin = freqs.sin()[None, None, :, :]
    out_real = x_real * cos - x_imag * sin
    out_imag = x_real * sin + x_imag * cos

    return torch.stack([out_real, out_imag], dim=-1).reshape(x.shape).to(x.dtype)

# 优势：天然支持相对位置 + 长度外推
examples.desc: RoPE 旋转位置编码 PyTorch 实现

enShortDesc: Rotary Position Embedding: encodes position by rotating query/key vectors. Better length extrapolation than absolute positions.
enLongDesc: RoPE (Su et al. 2021) encodes positional information by rotating the query and key vectors. Naturally supports relative positions and length extrapolation. Used in LLaMA, Mistral, many others.

name: ALiBi
shortDesc: 通过线性偏置注意力分数编码相对位置。无额外参数的轻量方案。
longDesc:
ALiBi (Attention with Linear Biases)：通过线性偏置注意力分数编码相对位置。

优势：无额外参数；外推到更长序列。

用户：MPT / BLOOM

examples.code:
# ALiBi: Attention with Linear Biases
# 替代 rope/absolute position encoding
# 原理：给 attention score 加线性距离 bias

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def alibi_attention(Q, K, alibi_bias):
    # Q, K: (batch, heads, seq, d_k)
    # alibi_bias: (batch, heads, seq, seq) — 预计算
    scores = (Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)) / (Q.size(-1) ** 0.5)
    scores = scores + alibi_bias   # 加线性 bias
    return F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)

# 生成 alibi bias
def get_alibi_bias(n_heads, seq_len):
    slopes = torch.tensor([2 ** -((i + 1) * 8 / n_heads) for i in range(n_heads)])
    # distance matrix
    pos = torch.arange(seq_len)
    distance = (pos.unsqueeze(0) - pos.unsqueeze(1)).abs().float()  # (seq, seq)
    alibi = -slopes.view(-1, 1, 1) * distance.view(1, seq_len, seq_len)
    return alibi.unsqueeze(0)   # (1, heads, seq, seq)

# 优势：
# - 无需训练位置参数（省参数）
# - 天然支持更长 context（外推性好）
# - 计算便宜
examples.desc: ALiBi 注意力 bias PyTorch 实现

quotes.text: ALiBi: a simple, parameter-free positional encoding with strong length extrapolation.

enShortDesc: Attention with Linear Biases: a simple parameter-free positional encoding with strong length extrapolation.
enLongDesc: ALiBi (Press et al. 2022) adds a linear distance-based bias to attention scores instead of using learned positional embeddings. No extra parameters, strong length extrapolation.

name: Quantization (INT8/INT4/NF4)
shortDesc: 降低模型权重精度（FP16 → INT8/INT4/NF4）以减少内存和加速推理。
longDesc:
降低模型权重数值精度以减少内存和加速推理。

精度：FP16 → INT8 / INT4 / NF4

权衡：精度下降 vs 内存 / 速度提升

代表实现：bitsandbytes / GPTQ / AWQ / SmoothQuant

examples.code:
# Model Quantization: FP32 → FP16 → INT8 → INT4
# 目的：减少模型大小 + 加速推理（牺牲一点精度）

# 1. bitsandbytes (HuggingFace)
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, BitsAndBytesConfig

bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(
    load_in_4bit=True,                    # 4-bit 量化
    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype="bfloat16",    # 计算用 bf16
    bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",            # NormalFloat4 (LLM 最优)
)

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    "meta-llama/Llama-3-70b",
    quantization_config=bnb_config,
    device_map="auto",
)
# 70B FP16 → 35GB → 4-bit: 17.5GB（单 24GB GPU 可跑）

# 2. GPTQ (post-training, GPU-friendly)

name: Distillation
shortDesc: 用大模型的输出训练小模型，保留大部分能力但降低推理成本。
longDesc:
蒸馏：用大模型（teacher）的输出训练小模型（student），保留大部分能力但降低推理成本。

代表：DeepSeek R1 蒸馏到 Qwen / Llama 系列。

examples.code:
# Knowledge Distillation: 大模型知识转移到小模型
# Teacher: 7B 模型
# Student: 1.5B 模型
# 目标: student 模仿 teacher 的 soft logits

import torch.nn.functional as F

def distillation_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, temperature=3.0):
    """
    Higher temperature = softer distribution = more knowledge transfer
    """
    soft_student = F.log_softmax(student_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    soft_teacher = F.softmax(teacher_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    return F.kl_div(soft_student, soft_teacher, reduction='batchmean') * (temperature ** 2)

# 总损失 = α * distillation + (1-α) * hard_target
loss = 0.7 * distillation_loss(s_logits, t_logits) + 0.3 * F.cross_entropy(s_logits, labels)

# 效果：DistilBERT 保留 97% 性能，60% 体积，60% 速度
examples.desc: Distillation loss 公式 + 实战数据

enShortDesc: Train a small model to mimic a larger one's outputs. DistilBERT retains 97% of BERT quality at 60% size.
enLongDesc: Knowledge distillation trains a small (student) model to match the soft probability distribution of a larger (teacher) model. The student learns the teacher's 'dark knowledge' beyond hard labels.

name: Fine-Tuning
shortDesc: 在预训练模型基础上用领域数据继续训练。
longDesc:
在预训练模型基础上用领域数据继续训练。

类型：

  • SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)：监督学习
  • RLHF / DPO / RLAIF：对齐训练
  • Instruction Tuning：指令遵循

参数高效方法：LoRA / QLoRA / PEFT / Prefix Tuning

examples.code:
# LoRA/QLoRA Fine-tuning（替代全参数微调）
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM

    bias="none",

quotes.text: Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model to a specific task with much less compute than training from scratch.

enShortDesc: Adapting a pre-trained model to a specific task by continuing training on task-specific data.
enLongDesc: Fine-tuning continues training a pre-trained model on task-specific data. Modern variants (LoRA, QLoRA) only train a small subset of parameters to save compute.

name: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
shortDesc: 参数高效微调：只更新小的低秩矩阵，大幅降低训练成本。
longDesc:
LoRA：参数高效微调方法，只更新小的低秩矩阵，大幅降低训练成本。

衍生：QLoRA（量化 + LoRA）/ PEFT / Prefix Tuning

quotes.text: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models. Trains 0.1% of parameters, retains 95%+ of quality.

examples.code:
# LoRA: 低秩适配微调
# 标准 fine-tuning 更新所有 W 矩阵 (e.g., 7B params)
# LoRA: 冻结 W，添加低秩旁路 W' = A @ B
#   A: (d × r), B: (r × d), r << d
#   参数量: r × 2d vs d × ×
# 7B model + r=16: 训练 0.1% 参数

from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model

config = LoraConfig(
    r=16,                   # rank
    lora_alpha=32,          # scaling
    target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"],   # 只在 attention 层加 LoRA
    lora_dropout=0.05,
    bias="none",
    task_type="CAUSAL_LM"
)

model = get_peft_model(base_model, config)
model.print_trainable_parameters()
# trainable params: 4,194,304 || all params: 7,000,000,000 || 0.06%
examples.desc: LoRA 标准用法 + 参数量对比

enShortDesc: Low-Rank Adaptation: train 0.1% of parameters, retain 95%+ quality. The dominant efficient fine-tuning method.
enLongDesc: LoRA (Hu et al. 2021) freezes pre-trained weights and adds a low-rank decomposition (A × B) that learns the task. Trains 0.1-1% of parameters, retains near-full quality.

name: QLoRA
shortDesc: 4-bit 量化 + LoRA：单 GPU 可微调 65B 模型。
longDesc: QLoRA：4-bit 量化 + LoRA——单 GPU 可微调 65B 模型。

quotes.text: QLoRA: 4-bit quantized base + LoRA adapter. Trains a 65B model on a single 48GB GPU.

examples.code:
# QLoRA: 4-bit base + LoRA adapter
# 1. 把 base model 量化到 4-bit (NF4)
# 2. 添加 LoRA adapter (bf16)
# 3. 只训练 LoRA 参数

from transformers import BitsAndBytesConfig
from peft import LoraConfig, prepare_model_for_kbit_training

bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(
    load_in_4bit=True,
    bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype="bfloat16",
    bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,
)

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    "meta-llama/Llama-3-70b",
    quantization_config=bnb_config,
    device_map="auto",
)
model = prepare_model_for_kbit_training(model)

# 加 LoRA
lora_config = LoraConfig(r=64, lora_alpha=16, target_modules="all-linear")
model = get_peft_model(model, lora_config)

# 效果：65B model 单 48GB GPU 可训练，95%+ 质量
examples.desc: QLoRA 完整 pipeline

enShortDesc: 4-bit quantized base + LoRA adapter. Trains a 65B model on a single 48GB GPU with no quality loss.
enLongDesc: QLoRA (Dettmers et al. 2023) combines 4-bit quantization of the base model with LoRA adapters in bf16. Enables fine-tuning of large models on consumer GPUs.

name: PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning)
shortDesc: 参数高效微调的总称。LoRA / QLoRA / Prefix Tuning 都属此类。
longDesc:
PEFT：Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning 的总称。

代表方法：LoRA / QLoRA / Prefix Tuning / Prompt Tuning / Adapter

examples.code:
# PEFT: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
# HuggingFace 库统一多种参数高效微调方法

from peft import (
    LoraConfig, get_peft_model,           # LoRA / QLoRA
    PromptTuningConfig,                   # Prompt Tuning
    PrefixTuningConfig,                   # Prefix Tuning
    IA3Config,                            # IA^3
)

# 1. LoRA (most popular)

model = get_peft_model(base_model, lora)

# 2. Prompt Tuning (smallest, <1k params)
prompt_config = PromptTuningConfig(
    num_virtual_tokens=20,
    prompt_tuning_init="TEXT",
    prompt_tuning_init_text="Classify if this text is positive:",
)

enShortDesc: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning: a unified library for LoRA, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, IA^3, and more.
enLongDesc: PEFT (HuggingFace library) provides unified implementations of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods. Train <1% of params, retain most quality.

name: RLHF
shortDesc: 用人类偏好数据训练 reward model，再用 RL 优化 LLM。
longDesc:
RLHF（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback）：

  1. 收集人类偏好数据（A vs B）
  2. 训练 reward model
  3. 用 PPO 等 RL 算法优化 LLM

应用：ChatGPT / Claude 早期对齐

quotes.text: RLHF: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. Aligns LLMs to human preferences via reward modeling.
quotes.cite: Christiano et al. 2017 / Ouyang et al. 2022

examples.code:

# 2. Reward Model: 人类对多个 output 排序，训练 reward model
# 3. PPO: 用 reward model 作 reward signal，policy gradient 训练

# 关键问题：
# - reward hacking（model 学会 exploit RM 而非真改进）
# - 人类标注不一致
# - 计算昂贵（每次 PPO step 需 RM inference）

# 替代方案：

# - KTO: Kahneman-Tversky 优化

enShortDesc: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: 3-stage training (SFT → Reward Model → PPO). The original alignment method.
enLongDesc: RLHF (Ouyang et al. 2022) aligns LLMs to human preferences via: (1) supervised fine-tuning, (2) training a reward model on human preference rankings, (3) PPO reinforcement learning with the reward model.

name: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization)
shortDesc: 无需 reward model，直接用偏好数据优化 LLM。比 RLHF 更简单稳定。
longDesc:
DPO：无需 reward model，直接用偏好数据优化 LLM。比 RLHF 更简单稳定。

变体：ORPO / IPO / SimPO

quotes.text: DPO: Direct Preference Optimization. Replaces RLHF with a simple classification loss.

examples.code:
# DPO: Direct Preference Optimization
# 不需要 reward model，直接用偏好对 (chosen, rejected) 优化

from trl import DPOTrainer, DPOConfig

config = DPOConfig(
    beta=0.1,                  # KL 约束强度
    learning_rate=1e-6,
    batch_size=4,
)

trainer = DPOTrainer(
    model=base_model,
    ref_model=None,            # 用 peft 模式共享 base
    args=config,
    train_dataset=preference_dataset,  # {prompt, chosen, rejected}
    tokenizer=tokenizer,
)
trainer.train()

# 优势 vs RLHF：
# - 单阶段训练
# - 无需 RM
# - 更稳定（无 reward hacking）
# - 论文: 75% 人类偏好 vs SFT baseline

enShortDesc: Direct Preference Optimization: replaces RLHF with a simple classification loss. No reward model needed.
enLongDesc: DPO (Rafailov et al. 2023) optimizes the LLM directly on preference pairs (chosen, rejected) using a simple cross-entropy loss. No reward model, more stable than RLHF.

longDesc:
RLAIF（RL from AI Feedback）：用AI 生成偏好标签替代人类。

enLongDesc: RLAIF (Lee et al. 2023, Anthropic Constitutional AI) replaces human preference labeling with AI-generated preferences based on a set of principles. Scalable, consistent.

name: ORPO
shortDesc: Odds Ratio Preference Optimization：SFT + DPO 一体化训练。
longDesc: ORPO：SFT + DPO 一体化的偏好优化方法。
enShortDesc: Odds Ratio Preference Optimization: combines SFT and DPO in one step. No reference model needed.
enLongDesc: ORPO (Hong et al. 2024) folds supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization into a single objective using odds ratio. No reference model, simpler pipeline than DPO.

name: IPO (Identity Preference Optimization)
shortDesc: 改进 DPO 避免过拟合的偏好优化方法。
longDesc: IPO：改进 DPO 避免过拟合的偏好优化方法。
enShortDesc: Identity Preference Optimization: fixes DPO's overfitting by using an identity instead of a log-sigmoid.
enLongDesc: IPO (Azar et al. 2023) replaces DPO's log-sigmoid with an identity loss, preventing the model from overfitting to preference data and producing deterministic outputs.

name: Function Calling

LLM 输出结构化 JSON 参数触发外部函数。

  3. 应用执行函数

name: Structured Outputs
shortDesc: LLM 输出严格遵循 JSON Schema。OpenAI 2024 推出 guaranteed adherence。
longDesc:
让 LLM 输出严格遵循 JSON Schema。

实现：Constrained Decoding / Grammar-based generation

代表：OpenAI Structured Outputs / Anthropic tool use / Gemini structured output

examples.code:
# OpenAI Structured Outputs (JSON Schema 严格模式)
import openai
from pydantic import BaseModel

class CalendarEvent(BaseModel):
    name: str
    date: str
    participants: list[str]

resp = openai.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-2024-08-06",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Alice 和 Bob 7 月 15 日开会讨论 Q3 OKR"}],
    response_format={
        "type": "json_schema",
        "json_schema": {
            "name": "calendar_event",
            "schema": CalendarEvent.model_json_schema(),
            "strict": True,         # ← 严格模式：模型不能编造字段
        },
    },
)
event = CalendarEvent.model_validate_json(resp.choices[0].message.content)
# → 100% schema-compliant, 无需 retry

quotes.text: Structured Outputs ensures model outputs exactly match your JSON Schema.

enShortDesc: Force the LLM to output JSON matching a specific schema. OpenAI's strict mode guarantees 100% schema compliance.
enLongDesc: Structured outputs (OpenAI 2024, others) constrain the LLM to emit tokens matching a JSON schema. No retries needed; 100% schema-compliant. Use Pydantic or similar for type safety.

name: Constrained Decoding
shortDesc: 用 grammar/JSON schema 限制 LLM 输出格式。保证 100% schema 遵循。
longDesc:
用 grammar / JSON schema限制 LLM 输出格式。

原理：在 token 选择时屏蔽不符合 grammar 的 token。

优势：100% 遵循 schema，无需后处理。

examples.code:
# Constrained Decoding: 强制 LLM 输出符合 schema
# 用 Outlines / Guidance 等库实现

import outlines

@outlines.prompt
def generate_user():
    """Generate a user profile as JSON."""

generator = outlines.generate.json(
    model,
    UserProfile,   # Pydantic model
)

# 输出严格匹配 schema
user = generator("Alice is 30, lives in Tokyo, likes coding")

# 优势：
# - 无需 retry
# - 100% schema 兼容
# - token-level 约束（vs response-level 校验）

# 应用：
# - 结构化输出 (OpenAI JSON mode 类似)
# - 代码生成（必须匹配语法）
# - SQL 生成（必须有效）
examples.desc: Outlines 库 constrained decoding

enShortDesc: Force LLM output to match a schema at the token level. Tools: Outlines, Guidance, JSONformer.
enLongDesc: Constrained decoding uses finite-state machines or context-free grammars to mask invalid tokens during generation. 100% guaranteed valid output, no retries.

name: Sampling (Temperature / Top-p / Top-k)
shortDesc: 控制 LLM 输出多样性的参数：temperature / top-p / top-k。
longDesc:
控制 LLM 输出多样性的采样参数：

  • Temperature：0=确定，1=标准，>1=更随机
  • Top-p (Nucleus Sampling)：累积概率阈值
  • Top-k：候选 token 数
  • Greedy Decoding：temperature=0 等价
  • Beam Search：保留 top-K 序列

examples.code:
# Sampling 策略对比
# 1. Greedy: 永远选概率最高的 token
# - 优点: 确定、可复现
# - 缺点: 容易重复、单调
# - 适用: factual QA

# 2. Top-K: 从概率最高的 K 个 token 中采样
# K=40 是 OpenAI 默认
# 优点: 限制离谱 token
# 缺点: K 固定，分布稀疏时浪费

# 3. Top-p (nucleus): 累积概率 ≥ p 的最小 token 集合
# p=0.9 通常效果好
# 优点: 自适应集合大小
# 缺点: 计算稍慢

# 4. Temperature: logits / temp 再 softmax
# temp=0 → greedy, temp=1 → 标准, temp=2 → 更有创意

# 实战：
# 创意写作: temp=1.0, top_p=0.9
# 代码生成: temp=0.2, top_p=0.95
# 翻译: temp=0.3, top_k=40
examples.desc: 4 种 sampling 策略对比 + 实战参数

enShortDesc: Strategies for picking tokens from the LLM's probability distribution: greedy, top-k, top-p, temperature.
enLongDesc: Sampling controls randomness in token generation. Greedy (deterministic), top-k (limit to top K), top-p / nucleus (cumulative probability), and temperature (logit scaling) are the main strategies.

# Browser-Use 库 — 让 LLM 操控浏览器
from browser_use import Agent
from langchain_anthropic import ChatAnthropic

agent = Agent(
    task="在 Hacker News 上找最近一篇关于 vibe coding 的文章，提取标题和评论数",
    llm=ChatAnthropic(model="claude-sonnet-4-5"),
)

result = await agent.run()
